searchText: Execution spec tests new release ✨ https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/v2.0.0 There are breaking changes included, so please take a look at the release notes! `ShanghaiToCancunAtTime15k` is not valid revision for a StateTest. Thanks for checking the tests and bringing this up! It's an easy fix and can be avoided completely in the future by throwing an exception if a state test attempts to use a transition fork, I'll open up a PR with the fix asap 👍 I reported the issue. I think you should resolve the concrete fork name at test generation using the block number. How are you generating a `StateTest` when the test definition has multiple transactions/blocks? It doesn't allow multiple transactions or blocks, it's just that it allows for any fork, and possibly when converting the tests from blockchain tests we left some test with the transition fork
